title: CAMP Series
description: Items in this collection are part of our CAMP series! 10% of the sales of this item will be donated to help make summer camp accessible to kids who might not be able to afford it. We believe that by providing this opportunity to kids they will be able to gain exposure to the outdoors, learn about nature while building new friendships, all of which are amazing childhood experiences.  Donations for this item will go to the 'Happy Camper Fund' an organization located in High Park Toronto, right around the corner from our basecamp/storefront.
